content.text:
CORVANE MUTUAL · SPECIAL HANDLING · INTERNAL

Corvane have asked that claims they mark "special handling" be outside our right to inspect. Legal objected. The objection was withdrawn on the 11th after a call from the chairman's office.

We now cover 60% of losses we are not allowed to look at. Three such claims so far, all from cold storage sites, all paid within a week.

I have kept copies of what Corvane sent us before the clause was signed. They are in the treaty book, under C-88214.

H. Lindsay
